title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Recording a Resolution Intent and the In-Person Successor Declaration
content:
## In-person declaration by a successor

A successor in interest who declares how the loan will be resolved on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases death case files the declaration in person. The declared intent is recorded on the case as the successor's intent on the day it is declared, provided the declaration meets the acceptance conditions below.

## Acceptance conditions

An intent is recorded only from an intent declaration already on file for the case:

- whose request status is received;
- made by the living borrower or, for a deceased borrower's loan, by a customer whose profile type is successor in interest linked to that borrower, as the plan's successor confirmation requirement provides;
- received no later than the response deadline.

A declaration by anyone else is declined as not a confirmed successor. One received later is declined as outside the response window.

For a successor in interest who declares in person on a Summit loan's death case, and only for such a declaration:

- the intent is recorded from the declaration the successor files in that same act;
- it is accepted only from such a successor;
- it is accepted only when the day it is filed is no later than the case's response deadline, the deadline day itself still counting.

A successor's intent declaration, and the evidence due date it carries, are taken only after the case shows a response deadline that falls on or after the day of the declaration.

| Declarant on a Summit death case | Day filed compared with the case's response deadline | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| successor in interest linked to the deceased borrower | before or on the deadline day | intent recorded that day |
| successor in interest linked to the deceased borrower | after the deadline | declined, outside the response window |
| anyone else | any | declined, not a confirmed successor |

## Filing the declaration: `declare_successor_intent_94ee6efc`

**Capability.** One call does three things:

- files an intent declaration from the declarant for the maturity case, dated today and marked accepted;
- records the declared intent on the case, with the declarant as the person acting on the case;
- prints an evidence due date on the declaration receipt.

The evidence due date is today's date moved later by the evidence due days supplied. It is the date by which the declarant's listing agreement or financing commitment is to be on file. The evidence due days also form part of the declaration's reference number. Afterwards the case lookup shows the recorded intent and declarant, and the request lookup shows the declaration.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `declare_successor_intent_94ee6efc` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it in person.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `maturity_case_id` | reference number of the deceased borrower's maturity case, read by the agent from the maturity case lookup and given to the declarant | identifier |
| `customer_id` | customer reference number of the declarant (the successor in interest), read by the agent from the customer lookup and given to the declarant | identifier |
| `stated_intent` | the resolution the declarant chooses | exactly one of `retain_property` (keep the home by paying the loan off), `sell_property` (sell the home and repay the loan from the sale), `deed_in_lieu` (hand the home to Cedarline by deed in lieu of foreclosure) |
| `evidence_due_days` | whole number of calendar days from today's date to the evidence due date printed on the declaration | integer of 1 or more, no unit text, no decimals |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with these fields:

- `maturity_request_id`, the declaration's reference number;
- `maturity_case_id`;
- `stated_intent`;
- `declarant_customer_id`, the person now recorded as acting on the case;
- `declaration_date`, today;
- `evidence_due_date`.

A receipt with a declaration reference number means the declaration is filed and recorded on the case. An unknown case reference returns an error naming it.
